## Context

F43A, F43B, and F44 are approved. MCP authentication documentation calls four implemented strategies unavailable. An SSO module links to a missing runbook. S3 guidance and ADR 0093 prescribe a rejected config command form.

## Plan

- Describe static, JWT, introspection, proxy, and custom MCP authentication strategies as implemented.
- Correct AuthConfigError documentation without changing fail-closed behavior.
- Link the approved SSO module reference to infra/runbooks/sso-auth-host.md.
- Replace rebar config -c with persistent sync.remote configuration in rebar.toml.
- Preserve ADR 0093 decision substance and status.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] MCP authentication module documentation describes all five implemented strategies.
- [ ] AuthConfigError documentation matches the implemented error contract.
- [ ] The approved missing runbook reference resolves to infra/runbooks/sso-auth-host.md.
- [ ] S3 setup examples use supported persistent project configuration.
- [ ] S3 back-out examples use supported persistent project configuration.
- [ ] Authentication behavior remains unchanged.
- [ ] S3 behavior remains unchanged.
- [ ] ADR 0093 decision substance remains unchanged.
- [ ] ADR 0093 status remains unchanged.
- [ ] The commands in Verification pass.
- [ ] The separate auth/RUNBOOK.md reference remains outside this approved scope.

## Verification

- `env PATH="$PWD/.venv/bin:$PATH" pytest tests/interfaces/facades/test_mcp_auth.py tests/interfaces/facades/test_mcp_auth_introspection.py tests/interfaces/facades/test_mcp_auth_custom.py tests/interfaces/facades/test_mcp_auth_jwks.py tests/interfaces/facades/test_mcp_auth_proxy.py tests/unit/test_sync_remote_config.py`
- `env PATH="$PWD/.venv/bin:$PATH" make lint`
- `env PATH="$PWD/.venv/bin:$PATH" make typecheck`
- `git diff --check`
- Inspect the S3 examples against the sync.remote configuration model.
- Inspect the authentication documentation against the implemented verifier classes and AuthConfigError call sites.
